info.description: When the God of Destruction lay waste to Ayanad and its mages, he unleashed a fury unknown to him since birth. From that moment on, his magic was forever stripped of its gentleness.
Even as a god, he could not escape his human flaws. His obsession endured beyond ascension and led to the destruction of the Great Library.

info.where: Vanguard Armor can be dropped by Vanguard of Destruction and found in Treasure Chest.

info.description: Dismantle to obtain a variety of vases for decorating your house and plot.
info.where: Vase Set is obtained through trade.
